title: Coming And Going Without a Trace│來去無蹤
description: Illusionists will now spawn in raids and drop unique items.│幻術師現在會在突襲中生成，並且會掉落獨特的道具。
body:
# Function│功能
- The 5th, 6th, and 7th waves of the raid will spawn 1, 1, and 2 Illusioners respectively.│突襲的第5、6、7波會生成1、1、2名幻術師。
- When an illusionist is killed by a player, they will drop 0-1 emeralds. Each level of Looting enchantment increases the max number of emeralds by 1.│幻術師被玩家擊殺後會掉落0-1個綠寶石，每一等的掠奪附魔+1數量上限。
- The Illusionist will always drop 1 Eye of Backlash upon being killed.│幻術師被擊殺後固定掉落1個反噬之眼。
  - Eye of Backlash: Effective when held. If the holder's health drops below 50% after taking damage from a mob, it inflicts Blindness, Slowness II, Weakness, and Wither II on the mob for 20 seconds and consumes one Eye of Backlash. Cannot be stacked.│反噬之眼：手持時有效，持有者受到了生物造成的傷害後如果生命值低於50%，對該生物施加20秒的失明、緩速II、虛弱、凋零II，並消耗掉一個反噬之眼。不可堆疊。
- Illusionists are spawned with an Eye of Backlash.│幻術師生成時持有一個反噬之眼。
